4.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

N tha priest shall take some of tha log of oil, N pour it in2 tha palm of his own left hand:
N tha priest shall dip his right finger in tha oil dat is in his left hand, N shall sprinkle of tha oil wit his finger seven times before tha LORD:

N of tha rest of tha oil dat is in his hand shall tha priest put upon tha tip of tha right ear of him dat is 2 be cleansed, N upon tha thumb of his right hand, N upon tha great toe of his right foot, upon tha blood of tha trespass offering:
N tha remnant of tha oil dat is in tha priest’s hand he shall pour upon tha head of him dat is 2 be cleansed: N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 him before tha LORD.
N tha priest shall offer tha sin offering, N make an atonement 4 him dat is 2 be cleansed from his uncleanness; N afterward he shall kill tha burnt offering:
N tha priest shall offer tha burnt offering N tha food offering upon tha altar: N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 him, N he shall be clean.

N if he be poor, N cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb 4 a trespass offering 2 be waved, 2 make an atonement 4 him, N one tenth deal of fine flour mingled wit oil 4 a food offering, N a log of oil;
N two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able 2 get; N tha one shall be a sin offering, N tha other a burnt offering.
N he shall bring ’em on tha eighth day 4 his cleansing 2 tha priest, 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, before tha LORD.
N tha priest shall take tha lamb of tha trespass offering, N tha log of oil, N tha priest shall wave ’em 4 a wave offering before tha LORD:

N he shall kill tha lamb of tha trespass offering, N tha priest shall take some of tha blood of tha trespass offering, N put it upon tha tip of tha right ear of him dat is 2 be cleansed, N upon tha thumb of his right hand, N upon tha great toe of his right foot:
N tha priest shall pour of tha oil in2 tha palm of his own left hand:
N tha priest shall sprinkle wit his right finger some of tha oil dat is in his left hand seven times before tha LORD:

N tha priest shall put of tha oil dat is in his hand upon tha tip of tha right ear of him dat is 2 be cleansed, N upon tha thumb of his right hand, N upon tha great toe of his right foot, upon tha place of tha blood of tha trespass offering:
N tha rest of tha oil dat is in tha priest’s hand he shall put upon tha head of him dat is 2 be cleansed, 2 make an atonement 4 him before tha LORD.
N he shall offer tha one of tha turtledoves, or of tha young pigeons, such as he can get;
Even such as he is able 2 get, tha one 4 a sin offering, N tha other 4 a burnt offering, wit tha food offering: N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 him dat is 2 be cleansed before tha LORD.
Dis is tha law of him in whom is tha plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able 2 get dat which pertains 2 his cleansing.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
When y’all be come in2 tha land of Canaan, which I give 2 u 4 a possession, N I put tha plague of leprosy in a house of tha land of ur possession;
N he dat owneth tha house shall come N tell tha priest, sayin, It seems 2 me there is as it were a plague in tha house:

Then tha priest shall command dat dey empty tha house, before tha priest go in2 it 2 see tha plague, dat all dat is in tha house don’t be made unclean: N afterward tha priest shall go in 2 see tha house:

Then tha priest shall go out of tha house 2 tha door of tha house, N shut up tha house seven days:
N tha priest shall come again tha seventh day, N shall look: N, look, if tha plague be spread in tha walls of tha house;
Then tha priest shall command dat dey take away tha stones in which tha plague is, N dey shall cast ’em in2 an unclean place without tha city:
N he shall cause tha house 2 be scraped within round about, N dey shall pour out tha dust dat dey scrape off without tha city in2 an unclean place:
N dey shall take other stones, N put ’em in tha place of dose stones; N he shall take other morter, N shall plaister tha house.
N if tha plague come again, N break out in tha house, after dat he has taken away tha stones, N after he has scraped tha house, N after it is plaistered;
Then tha priest shall come N look, N, look, if tha plague be spread in tha house, it is a fretting leprosy in tha house: it is unclean.
N he shall break down tha house, tha stones of it, N tha timber of it, N all tha morter of tha house; N he shall carry ’em forth out of tha city in2 an unclean place.
Moreover he dat goes in2 tha house all tha while dat it is shut up shall be unclean until tha even.

N if tha priest shall come in, N look upon it, N, look, tha plague has not spread in tha house, after tha house was plaistered: then tha priest shall pronounce tha house clean, because tha plague is healed.
N he shall take 2 cleanse tha house two birds, N cedar wood, N scarlet, N hyssop:
N he shall kill tha one of tha birds in an earthen vessel over runnin water:
N he shall take tha cedar wood, N tha hyssop, N tha scarlet, N tha livin bird, N dip ’em in tha blood of tha killed bird, N in tha runnin water, N sprinkle tha house seven times:
N he shall cleanse tha house wit tha blood of tha bird, N wit tha runnin water, N wit tha livin bird, N wit tha cedar wood, N wit tha hyssop, N wit tha scarlet:
But he shall let go tha livin bird out of tha city in2 tha open fields, N make an atonement 4 tha house: N it will be clean.
Dis is tha law 4 all manner of plague of leprosy, N scall,
N 4 tha leprosy of a garment, N of a house,
N 4 a risin, N 4 a scab, N 4 a bright spot:
2 teach when it is unclean, N when it is clean: dis is tha law of leprosy.

15.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses N 2 Aaron, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When any man has a runnin issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
N dis shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run wit his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
Every bed, whereon he lies dat has tha issue, is unclean: N every thing, whereon he sits, shall be unclean.
N whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N he dat sits on any thing whereon he sat dat has tha issue shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N he dat touches tha flesh of him dat has tha issue shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N if he dat has tha issue spit upon him dat is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N what saddle soever he rides upon dat has tha issue shall be unclean.
N whoever touches any thing dat was under him shall be unclean until tha even: N he dat bears any of dose things shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N whoever he touches dat has tha issue, N has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N tha vessel of earth, dat he touches which has tha issue, shall be broken: N every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
N when he dat has an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number 2 himself seven days 4 his cleansing, N wash his clothes, N bathe his flesh in runnin water, N shall be clean.
N on tha eighth day he shall take 2 him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, N come before tha LORD 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N give ’em 2 tha priest:
N tha priest shall offer ’em, tha one 4 a sin offering, N tha other 4 a burnt offering; N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 him before tha LORD 4 his issue.
N if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N every garment, N every skin, whereon is tha seed of copulation, shall be washed wit water, N be unclean until tha even.
Tha woman also wit whom man shall lie wit seed of copulation, dey shall both bathe themselves in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N if a woman have an issue, N her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: N whoever touches her shall be unclean until tha even.
N every thing dat she lies upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also dat she sits upon shall be unclean.
N whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N whoever touches any thing dat she sat upon shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
N if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until tha even.
N if any man lie wit her at all, N her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; N all tha bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.

N if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of tha time of her separation, or if it run beyond tha time of her separation; all tha days of tha issue of her uncleanness shall be as tha days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
Every bed whereon she lies all tha days of her issue shall be 2 her as tha bed of her separation: N whatever she sits upon shall be unclean, as tha uncleanness of her separation.
N whoever touches dose things shall be unclean, N shall wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even.
But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number 2 herself seven days, N after dat she shall be clean.
N on tha eighth day she shall take 2 her two turtles, or two young pigeons, N bring ’em 2 tha priest, 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N tha priest shall offer tha one 4 a sin offering, N tha other 4 a burnt offering; N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 her before tha LORD 4 tha issue of her uncleanness.
Like dis shall y’all separate tha children of Israel from their uncleanness; dat dey die not in their uncleanness, when dey defile my tabernacle dat is among ’em.
Dis is tha law of him dat has an issue, N of him whose seed goes from him, N is defiled wit it;
N of her dat is sick of her flowers, N of him dat has an issue, of tha man, N of tha woman, N of him dat lies wit her dat is unclean.

16.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses after tha death of tha two sons of Aaron, when dey offered before tha LORD, N died;

N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Speak 2 Aaron ur brother, dat he come not at all times in2 tha holy place within tha vail before tha mercy seat, which is upon tha ark; dat he die not: 4 I will appear in tha cloud upon tha mercy seat.
Like dis shall Aaron come in2 tha holy place: wit a young bullock 4 a sin offering, N a ram 4 a burnt offering.

He shall put on tha holy linen coat, N he shall have tha linen breeches upon his flesh, N shall be girded wit a linen girdle, N wit tha linen mitre shall he be attired: dese r holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, N so put ’em on.
N he shall take of tha congregation of tha children of Israel two kids of tha goats 4 a sin offering, N one ram 4 a burnt offering.
N Aaron shall offer his bullock of tha sin offering, which is 4 himself, N make an atonement 4 himself, N 4 his house.
N he shall take tha two goats, N present ’em before tha LORD at tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N Aaron shall cast lots upon tha two goats; one lot 4 tha LORD, N tha other lot 4 tha scapegoat.
N Aaron shall bring tha goat upon which tha LORD’s lot fell, N offer him 4 a sin offering.
But tha goat, on which tha lot fell 2 be tha scapegoat, shall be presented alive before tha LORD, 2 make an atonement wit him, N 2 let him go 4 a scapegoat in2 tha wilderness.
N Aaron shall bring tha bullock of tha sin offering, which is 4 himself, N shall make an atonement 4 himself, N 4 his house, N shall kill tha bullock of tha sin offering which is 4 himself:
N he shall take a censer full of burnin coals of fire from off tha altar before tha LORD, N his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, N bring it within tha vail:
N he shall put tha incense upon tha fire before tha LORD, dat tha cloud of tha incense may cover tha mercy seat dat is upon tha testimony, dat he die not:
N he shall take of tha blood of tha bullock, N sprinkle it wit his finger upon tha mercy seat eastward; N before tha mercy seat shall he sprinkle of tha blood wit his finger seven times.

Then shall he kill tha goat of tha sin offering, dat is 4 tha people, N bring his blood within tha vail, N do wit dat blood as he did wit tha blood of tha bullock, N sprinkle it upon tha mercy seat, N before tha mercy seat:

N he shall make an atonement 4 tha holy place, because of tha uncleanness of tha children of Israel, N because of their transgressions in all their sins: N so shall he do 4 tha tabernacle of tha congregation, dat remains among ’em in tha midst of their uncleanness.

N there shall be no man in tha tabernacle of tha congregation when he goes in 2 make an atonement in tha holy place, until he come out, N have made an atonement 4 himself, N 4 his household, N 4 all tha congregation of Israel.
N he shall go out 2 tha altar dat is before tha LORD, N make an atonement 4 it; N shall take of tha blood of tha bullock, N of tha blood of tha goat, N put it upon tha horns of tha altar round about.
N he shall sprinkle of tha blood upon it wit his finger seven times, N cleanse it, N hallow it from tha uncleanness of tha children of Israel.
N when he has made an end of reconciling tha holy place, N tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N tha altar, he shall bring tha live goat:

N Aaron shall lay both his hands upon tha head of tha live goat, N confess over him all tha iniquities of tha children of Israel, N all their transgressions in all their sins, puttin ’em upon tha head of tha goat, N shall send him away by tha hand of a fit man in2 tha wilderness:
N tha goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities 2 a land not inhabited: N he shall let go tha goat in tha wilderness.
N Aaron shall come in2 tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N shall put off tha linen garments, which he put on when he went in2 tha holy place, N shall leave ’em there:

N he shall wash his flesh wit water in tha holy place, N put on his garments, N come forth, N offer his burnt offering, N tha burnt offering of tha people, N make an atonement 4 himself, N 4 tha people.
N tha fat of tha sin offering shall he burn upon tha altar.
N he dat let go tha goat 4 tha scapegoat shall wash his clothes, N bathe his flesh in water, N afterward come in2 tha camp.

N tha bullock 4 tha sin offering, N tha goat 4 tha sin offering, whose blood was brought in 2 make atonement in tha holy place, shall one carry forth without tha camp; N dey shall burn in tha fire their skins, N their flesh, N their dung.
N he dat burns ’em shall wash his clothes, N bathe his flesh in water, N afterward he shall come in2 tha camp.

N dis shall be a statute 4 ever 2 u: dat in tha seventh month, on tha tenth day of tha month, y’all shall afflict ur souls, N do no work at all, whether it be one of ur own country, or a stranger dat stays among u:
4 on dat day shall tha priest make an atonement 4 u, 2 cleanse u, dat y’all may be clean from all ur sins before tha LORD.
It shall be a sabbath of rest 2 u, N y’all shall afflict ur souls, by a statute 4 ever.

N tha priest, whom he shall anoint, N whom he shall consecrate 2 minister in tha priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make tha atonement, N shall put on tha linen clothes, even tha holy garments:

N he shall make an atonement 4 tha holy sanctuary, N he shall make an atonement 4 tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N 4 tha altar, N he shall make an atonement 4 tha priests, N 4 all tha people of tha congregation.
N dis shall be an everlasting statute 2 u, 2 make an atonement 4 tha children of Israel 4 all their sins once a year. N he did as tha LORD commanded Moses.

17.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Aaron, N 2 his sons, N 2 all tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em; dis is tha thing which tha LORD has commanded, sayin,
What man soever there be of tha house of Israel, dat kills an ox, or lamb, or goat, in tha camp, or dat kills it out of tha camp,

N brings it not 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 2 offer an offering 2 tha LORD before tha tabernacle of tha LORD; blood shall be imputed 2 dat man; he has shed blood; N dat man shall be cut off from among his people:

2 tha end dat tha children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which dey offer in tha open field, even dat dey may bring ’em 2 tha LORD, 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 2 tha priest, N offer ’em 4 peace offerings 2 tha LORD.
N tha priest shall sprinkle tha blood upon tha altar of tha LORD at tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N burn tha fat 4 a sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
N dey shall no more offer their sacrifices 2 devils, after whom dey have gone a whoring. dis shall be a statute 4 ever 2 ’em throughout their generations.
N u will say 2 ’em, whatever man there be of tha house of Israel, or of tha strangers which stay among u, dat offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
N brings it not 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, 2 offer it 2 tha LORD; even dat man shall be cut off from among his people.

N whatever man there be of tha house of Israel, or of tha strangers dat stay among u, dat eats any manner of blood; I will even set my face against dat soul dat eats blood, N will cut him off from among his people.
4 tha life of tha flesh is in tha blood: N I have given it 2 u upon tha altar 2 make an atonement 4 ur souls: 4 it is tha blood dat makes an atonement 4 tha soul.
Therefore I said 2 tha children of Israel, No soul of u shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger dat stays among u eat blood.

N whatever man there be of tha children of Israel, or of tha strangers dat stay among u, which hunteth N catcheth any beast or fowl dat may be eaten; he shall even pour out tha blood of it, N cover it wit dust.

4 it is tha life of all flesh; tha blood of it is 4 tha life of it: therefore I said 2 tha children of Israel, y’all shall eat tha blood of no manner of flesh: 4 tha life of all flesh is tha blood of it: whoever eats it shall be cut off.

N every soul dat eats dat which died of itself, or dat which was torn wit beasts, whether it be one of ur own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, N bathe himself in water, N be unclean until tha even: then shall he be clean.
But if he wash ’em not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

18.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, I am tha LORD ur God.

After tha doings of tha land of Egypt, in which y’all lived, shall y’all not do: N after tha doings of tha land of Canaan, where I bring u, shall y’all not do: neither shall y’all walk in their ordinances.
y’all shall do my judgments, N keep mine ordinances, 2 walk in it: I am tha LORD ur God.
y’all shall therefore keep my statutes, N my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in ’em: I am tha LORD.
None of u shall approach 2 any dat is near of kin 2 him, 2 uncover their nakedness: I am tha LORD.
Tha nakedness of ur father, or tha nakedness of ur mother, will u not uncover: she is ur mother; u will not uncover her nakedness.
Tha nakedness of ur father’s wife will u not uncover: it is ur father’s nakedness.
Tha nakedness of ur sister, tha daughter of ur father, or daughter of ur mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness u will not uncover.
Tha nakedness of ur son’s daughter, or of ur daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness u will not uncover: 4 theirs is ur own nakedness.
Tha nakedness of ur father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of ur father, she is ur sister, u will not uncover her nakedness.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur father’s sister: she is ur father’s near kinswoman.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur mother’s sister: 4 she is ur mother’s near kinswoman.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur father’s brother, u will not approach 2 his wife: she is thine aunt.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur daughter in law: she is ur son’s wife; u will not uncover her nakedness.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur brother’s wife: it is ur brother’s nakedness.
u will not uncover tha nakedness of a woman N her daughter, neither will u take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, 2 uncover her nakedness; 4 dey r her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
Neither will u take a wife 2 her sister, 2 vex her, 2 uncover her nakedness, beside tha other in her life time.
Also u will not approach 2 a woman 2 uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart 4 her uncleanness.
Moreover u will not lie carnally wit ur neighbour’s wife, 2 defile urself wit her.
N u will not let any of ur seed pass through tha fire 2 Molech, neither will u profane tha name of ur God: I am tha LORD.
u will not lie wit mankind, as wit womankind: it is abomination.
Neither will u lie wit any beast 2 defile urself wit it: neither shall any woman stand before a beast 2 lie down thereto: it is confusion.
Defile not y’all y’all in any of dese things: 4 in all dese tha nations r defiled which I cast out before u:
N tha land is defiled: therefore I do visit tha iniquity of it upon it, N tha land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
y’all shall therefore keep my statutes N my judgments, N shall not commit any of dese abominations; neither any of ur own nation, nor any stranger dat stays among u:
(4 all dese abominations have tha men of tha land done, which were before u, N tha land is defiled;)
Dat tha land spue not u out also, when y’all defile it, as it spued out tha nations dat were before u.
4 whoever shall commit any of dese abominations, even tha souls dat commit ’em shall be cut off from among their people.
Therefore shall y’all keep mine ordinance, dat y’all commit not any one of dese abominable customs, which were committed before u, N dat y’all defile not y’all in it: I am tha LORD ur God.

19.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 all tha congregation of tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, y’all shall be holy: 4 I tha LORD ur God am holy.
y’all shall fear every man his mother, N his father, N keep my sabbaths: I am tha LORD ur God.
Turn y’all not 2 idols, nor make 2 y’all molten gods: I am tha LORD ur God.
N if y’all offer a sacrifice of peace offerings 2 tha LORD, y’all shall offer it at ur own will.
It shall be eaten tha same day y’all offer it, N on tha morrow: N if ought remain until tha third day, it shall be burnt in tha fire.
N if it be eaten at all on tha third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
Therefore every one dat eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned tha hallowed thing of tha LORD: N dat soul shall be cut off from among his people.
N when y’all reap tha harvest of ur land, u will not wholly reap tha corners of ur field, neither will u gather tha gleanings of ur harvest.
N u will not glean ur vineyard, neither will u gather every grape of ur vineyard; u will leave ’em 4 tha poor N stranger: I am tha LORD ur God.
y’all shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one 2 another.
N y’all shall not swear by my name falsely, neither will u profane tha name of ur God: I am tha LORD.
u will not defraud ur neighbour, neither rob him: tha wages of him dat is hired shall not abide wit u all night until tha morning.
u will not curse tha deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before tha blind, but will fear ur God: I am tha LORD.
y’all shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: u will not respect tha person of tha poor, nor honour tha person of tha mighty: but in righteousness will u judge ur neighbour.
u will not go up N down as a talebearer among ur people: neither will u stand against tha blood of ur neighbour: I am tha LORD.
u will not hate ur brother in thine heart: u will in any wise rebuke ur neighbour, N not suffer sin upon him.
u will not avenge, nor bear any grudge against tha children of ur people, but u will love ur neighbour as urself: I am tha LORD.
y’all shall keep my statutes. u will not let ur cattle gender wit a diverse kind: u will not sow ur field wit mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen N woollen come upon u.

N whoever lies carnally wit a woman, dat is a bondmaid, betrothed 2 an husband, N not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; dey shall not be put 2 death, because she was not free.
N he shall bring his trespass offering 2 tha LORD, 2 tha door of tha tabernacle of tha congregation, even a ram 4 a trespass offering.
N tha priest shall make an atonement 4 him wit tha ram of tha trespass offering before tha LORD 4 his sin which he has done: N tha sin which he has done shall be forgiven him.

N when y’all shall come in2 tha land, N shall have planted all manner of trees 4 food, then y’all shall count tha fruit of it as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised 2 u: it shall not be eaten of.
But in tha fourth year all tha fruit of it shall be holy 2 praise tha LORD withal.
N in tha fifth year shall y’all eat of tha fruit of it, dat it may yield 2 u tha increase of it: I am tha LORD ur God.
y’all shall not eat any thing wit tha blood: neither shall y’all use enchantment, nor observe times.
y’all shall not round tha corners of ur heads, neither will u mar tha corners of ur beard.
y’all shall not make any cuttings in ur flesh 4 tha dead, nor print any marks upon u: I am tha LORD.
Do not prostitute ur daughter, 2 cause her 2 be a whore; lest tha land fall 2 whoredom, N tha land become full of wickedness.
y’all shall keep my sabbaths, N reverence my sanctuary: I am tha LORD.
Regard not ’em dat have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, 2 be defiled by ’em: I am tha LORD ur God.
u will rise up before tha hoary head, N honour tha face of tha old man, N fear ur God: I am tha LORD.
N if a stranger stay wit u in ur land, y’all shall not vex him.
But tha stranger dat lives wit u shall be 2 u as one born among u, N u will love him as urself; 4 y’all were strangers in tha land of Egypt: I am tha LORD ur God.
y’all shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, N a just hin, shall y’all have: I am tha LORD ur God, which brought u out of tha land of Egypt.
Therefore shall y’all observe all my statutes, N all my judgments, N do ’em: I am tha LORD.

20.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Again, u will say 2 tha children of Israel, whoever he be of tha children of Israel, or of tha strangers dat stay in Israel, dat gives any of his seed 2 Molech; he shall surely be put 2 death: tha people of tha land shall stone him wit stones.
N I will set my face against dat man, N will cut him off from among his people; because he has given of his seed 2 Molech, 2 defile my sanctuary, N 2 profane my holy name.
N if tha people of tha land do any ways hide their eyes from tha man, when he gives of his seed 2 Molech, N kill him not:
Then I will set my face against dat man, N against his family, N will cut him off, N all dat go a whoring after him, 2 commit whoredom wit Molech, from among their people.
N tha soul dat turns after such as have familiar spirits, N after wizards, 2 go a whoring after ’em, I will even set my face against dat soul, N will cut him off from among his people.
Sanctify y’all therefore, N be y’all holy: 4 I am tha LORD ur God.
N y’all shall keep my statutes, N do ’em: I am tha LORD which sanctify u.
4 every one dat curses his father or his mother shall be surely put 2 death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
N tha man dat commits adultery wit another man’s wife, even he dat commits adultery wit his neighbour’s wife, tha adulterer N tha adulteress shall surely be put 2 death.
N tha man dat lies wit his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of ’em shall surely be put 2 death; their blood shall be upon ’em.
N if a man lie wit his daughter in law, both of ’em shall surely be put 2 death: dey have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon ’em.
If a man also lie wit mankind, as he lies wit a woman, both of ’em have committed an abomination: dey shall surely be put 2 death; their blood shall be upon ’em.
N if a man take a wife N her mother, it is wickedness: dey shall be burnt wit fire, both he N dey; dat there be no wickedness among u.
N if a man lie wit a beast, he shall surely be put 2 death: N y’all shall kill tha beast.
N if a woman approach 2 any beast, N lie down thereto, u will kill tha woman, N tha beast: dey shall surely be put 2 death; their blood shall be upon ’em.

N if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, N see her nakedness, N she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; N dey shall be cut off in tha sight of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

N if a man shall lie wit a woman havin her sickness, N shall uncover her nakedness; he has discovered her fountain, N she has uncovered tha fountain of her blood: N both of ’em shall be cut off from among their people.
N u will not uncover tha nakedness of ur mother’s sister, nor of ur father’s sister: 4 he uncovereth his near kin: dey shall bear their iniquity.
N if a man shall lie wit his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: dey shall bear their sin; dey shall die childless.
N if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; dey shall be childless.
y’all shall therefore keep all my statutes, N all my judgments, N do ’em: dat tha land, where I bring u 2 live in it, spue u not out.
N y’all shall not walk in tha manners of tha nation, which I cast out before u: 4 dey committed all dese things, N therefore I abhorred ’em.
But I have said 2 u, y’all shall inherit their land, N I will give it 2 u 2 possess it, a land dat flows wit milk N honey: I am tha LORD ur God, which have separated u from other people.

y’all shall therefore put difference between clean beasts N unclean, N between unclean fowls N clean: N y’all shall not make ur souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of livin thing dat creeps on tha ground, which I have separated from u as unclean.
N y’all shall be holy 2 me: 4 I tha LORD am holy, N have severed u from other people, dat y’all should be mine.
A man also or woman dat has a familiar spirit, or dat is a wizard, shall surely be put 2 death: dey shall stone ’em wit stones: their blood shall be upon ’em.

21.text: N tha LORD said 2 Moses, Speak 2 tha priests tha sons of Aaron, N say 2 ’em, There shall none be defiled 4 tha dead among his people:
But 4 his kin, dat is near 2 him, dat is, 4 his mother, N 4 his father, N 4 his son, N 4 his daughter, N 4 his brother,
N 4 his sister a virgin, dat is nigh 2 him, which has had no husband; 4 her may he be defiled.
But he shall not defile himself, bein a chief man among his people, 2 profane himself.
Dey shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall dey shave off tha corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
Dey shall be holy 2 their God, N not profane tha name of their God: 4 tha offerings of tha LORD made by fire, N tha bread of their God, dey do offer: therefore dey shall be holy.
Dey shall not take a wife dat is a whore, or profane; neither shall dey take a woman put away from her husband: 4 he is holy 2 his God.
u will sanctify him therefore; 4 he offers tha bread of ur God: he shall be holy 2 u: 4 I tha LORD, which sanctify u, am holy.
N tha daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing tha whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt wit fire.
N he dat is tha high priest among his brothers, upon whose head tha anointing oil was poured, N dat is consecrated 2 put on tha garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
Neither shall he go in 2 any dead body, nor defile himself 4 his father, or 4 his mother;
Neither shall he go out of tha sanctuary, nor profane tha sanctuary of his God; 4 tha crown of tha anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am tha LORD.
N he shall take a wife in her virginity.
A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, dese shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people 2 wife.
Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: 4 I tha LORD do sanctify him.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Aaron, sayin, whoever he be of ur seed in their generations dat has any blemish, let him not approach 2 offer tha bread of his God.
4 whatever man he be dat has a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he dat has a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
Or a man dat is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or dat has a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or has his stones broken;
No man dat has a blemish of tha seed of Aaron tha priest shall come nigh 2 offer tha offerings of tha LORD made by fire: he has a blemish; he shall not come nigh 2 offer tha bread of his God.
He shall eat tha bread of his God, both of tha most holy, N of tha holy.
Only he shall not go in 2 tha vail, nor come nigh 2 tha altar, because he has a blemish; dat he profane not my sanctuaries: 4 I tha LORD do sanctify ’em.
N Moses told it 2 Aaron, N 2 his sons, N 2 all tha children of Israel.

22.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 Aaron N 2 his sons, dat dey separate themselves from tha holy things of tha children of Israel, N dat dey profane not my holy name in dose things which dey hallow 2 me: I am tha LORD.

Say 2 ’em, whoever he be of all ur seed among ur generations, dat goes 2 tha holy things, which tha children of Israel hallow 2 tha LORD, havin his uncleanness upon him, dat soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am tha LORD.

What man soever of tha seed of Aaron is a leper, or has a runnin issue; he shall not eat of tha holy things, until he be clean. N whoever touches any thing dat is unclean by tha dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;
Or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;
Tha soul which has touched any such shall be unclean until even, N shall not eat of tha holy things, unless he wash his flesh wit water.
N when tha sun is down, he shall be clean, N shall afterward eat of tha holy things; because it is his food.
Dat which dies of itself, or is torn wit beasts, he shall not eat 2 defile himself wit it: I am tha LORD.
Dey shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest dey bear sin 4 it, N die therefore, if dey profane it: I tha LORD do sanctify ’em.
There shall no stranger eat of tha holy thing: a sojourner of tha priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of tha holy thing.
But if tha priest buy any soul wit his money, he shall eat of it, N he dat is born in his house: dey shall eat of his food.
If tha priest’s daughter also be married 2 a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of tha holy things.
But if tha priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, N have no child, N is returned 2 her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s food: but there shall no stranger eat of it.
N if a man eat of tha holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put tha fifth part of it 2 it, N shall give it 2 tha priest wit tha holy thing.
N dey shall not profane tha holy things of tha children of Israel, which dey offer 2 tha LORD;
Or suffer ’em 2 bear tha iniquity of trespass, when dey eat their holy things: 4 I tha LORD do sanctify ’em.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Speak 2 Aaron, N 2 his sons, N 2 all tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, whatever he be of tha house of Israel, or of tha strangers in Israel, dat will offer his oblation 4 all his vows, N 4 all his freewill offerings, which dey will offer 2 tha LORD 4 a burnt offering;
y’all shall offer at ur own will a male without blemish, of tha beeves, of tha sheep, or of tha goats.
But whatever has a blemish, dat shall y’all not offer: 4 it shall not be acceptable 4 u.
N whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings 2 tha LORD 2 accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect 2 be accepted; there shall be no blemish in it.
Blind, or broken, or maimed, or havin a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, y’all shall not offer dese 2 tha LORD, nor make an offering by fire of ’em upon tha altar 2 tha LORD.
Either a bullock or a lamb dat has any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, dat may u offer 4 a freewill offering; but 4 a vow it shall not be accepted.
y’all shall not offer 2 tha LORD dat which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall y’all make any offering of it in ur land.
Neither from a stranger’s hand shall y’all offer tha bread of ur God of any of dese; because their corruption is in ’em, N blemishes be in ’em: dey shall not be accepted 4 u.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under tha dam; N from tha eighth day N thenceforth it shall be accepted 4 an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD.
N whether it be cow or ewe, y’all shall not kill it N her young both in one day.
N when y’all will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving 2 tha LORD, offer it at ur own will.
On tha same day it shall be eaten up; y’all shall leave none of it until tha morrow: I am tha LORD.
Therefore shall y’all keep my commandments, N do ’em: I am tha LORD.
Neither shall y’all profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among tha children of Israel: I am tha LORD which hallow u,
Dat brought u out of tha land of Egypt, 2 be ur God: I am tha LORD.

23.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, Concerning tha feasts of tha LORD, which y’all shall proclaim 2 be holy convocations, even dese r my feasts.
Six days shall work be done: but tha seventh day is tha sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; y’all shall do no work in it: it is tha sabbath of tha LORD in all ur dwellings.
Dese r tha feasts of tha LORD, even holy convocations, which y’all shall proclaim in their seasons.
In tha fourteenth day of tha first month at even is tha LORD’s passover.
N on tha fifteenth day of tha same month is tha feast of unleavened bread 2 tha LORD: seven days y’all must eat unleavened bread.
In tha first day y’all shall have an holy convocation: y’all shall do no servile work in it.
But y’all shall offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD seven days: in tha seventh day is an holy convocation: y’all shall do no servile work in it.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,

Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When y’all be come in2 tha land which I give 2 u, N shall reap tha harvest of it, then y’all shall bring a sheaf of tha firstfruits of ur harvest 2 tha priest:
N he shall wave tha sheaf before tha LORD, 2 be accepted 4 u: on tha morrow after tha sabbath tha priest shall wave it.
N y’all shall offer dat day when y’all wave tha sheaf an he lamb without blemish of tha first year 4 a burnt offering 2 tha LORD.

N tha food offering of it shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled wit oil, an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD 4 a sweet savour: N tha drink offering of it shall be of wine, tha fourth part of an hin.

N y’all shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until tha selfsame day dat y’all have brought an offering 2 ur God: it shall be a statute 4 ever throughout ur generations in all ur dwellings.
N y’all shall count 2 u from tha morrow after tha sabbath, from tha day dat y’all brought tha sheaf of tha wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
Even 2 tha morrow after tha seventh sabbath shall y’all number fifty days; N y’all shall offer a new food offering 2 tha LORD.
y’all shall bring out of ur habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: dey shall be of fine flour; dey shall be baken wit leaven; dey r tha firstfruits 2 tha LORD.

N y’all shall offer wit tha bread seven lambs without blemish of tha first year, N one young bullock, N two rams: dey shall be 4 a burnt offering 2 tha LORD, wit their food offering, N their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour 2 tha LORD.
Then y’all shall sacrifice one kid of tha goats 4 a sin offering, N two lambs of tha first year 4 a sacrifice of peace offerings.
N tha priest shall wave ’em wit tha bread of tha firstfruits 4 a wave offering before tha LORD, wit tha two lambs: dey shall be holy 2 tha LORD 4 tha priest.
N y’all shall proclaim on tha selfsame day, dat it may be an holy convocation 2 u: y’all shall do no servile work in it: it shall be a statute 4 ever in all ur dwellings throughout ur generations.

N when y’all reap tha harvest of ur land, u will not make clean riddance of tha corners of ur field when u reapest, neither will u gather any gleaning of ur harvest: u will leave ’em 2 tha poor, N 2 tha stranger: I am tha LORD ur God.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, In tha seventh month, in tha first day of tha month, shall y’all have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
y’all shall do no servile work in it: but y’all shall offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Also on tha tenth day of dis seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation 2 u; N y’all shall afflict ur souls, N offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD.
N y’all shall do no work in dat same day: 4 it is a day of atonement, 2 make an atonement 4 u before tha LORD ur God.
4 whatever soul it be dat shall not be afflicted in dat same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
N whatever soul it be dat does any work in dat same day, tha same soul will I destroy from among his people.
y’all shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute 4 ever throughout ur generations in all ur dwellings.
It shall be 2 u a sabbath of rest, N y’all shall afflict ur souls: in tha ninth day of tha month at even, from even 2 even, shall y’all celebrate ur sabbath.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, tha fifteenth day of dis seventh month shall be tha feast of tabernacles 4 seven days 2 tha LORD.
On tha first day shall be an holy convocation: y’all shall do no servile work in it.

Seven days y’all shall offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD: on tha eighth day shall be an holy convocation 2 u; N y’all shall offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD: it is a solemn assembly; N y’all shall do no servile work in it.

Dese r tha feasts of tha LORD, which y’all shall proclaim 2 be holy convocations, 2 offer an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD, a burnt offering, N a food offering, a sacrifice, N drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
Beside tha sabbaths of tha LORD, N beside ur gifts, N beside all ur vows, N beside all ur freewill offerings, which y’all give 2 tha LORD.

Also in tha fifteenth day of tha seventh month, when y’all have gathered in tha fruit of tha land, y’all shall keep a feast 2 tha LORD seven days: on tha first day shall be a sabbath, N on tha eighth day shall be a sabbath.
N y’all shall take u on tha first day tha boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, N tha boughs of thick trees, N willows of tha brook; N y’all shall rejoice before tha LORD ur God seven days.
N y’all shall keep it a feast 2 tha LORD seven days in tha year. It shall be a statute 4 ever in ur generations: y’all shall celebrate it in tha seventh month.
y’all shall live in booths seven days; all dat r Israelites born shall live in booths:
Dat ur generations may know dat I made tha children of Israel 2 live in booths, when I brought ’em out of tha land of Egypt: I am tha LORD ur God.
N Moses declared 2 tha children of Israel tha feasts of tha LORD.

24.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Command tha children of Israel, dat dey bring 2 u pure oil olive beaten 4 tha light, 2 cause tha lamps 2 burn continually.

Without tha vail of tha testimony, in tha tabernacle of tha congregation, shall Aaron order it from tha evening 2 tha morning before tha LORD continually: it shall be a statute 4 ever in ur generations.
He shall order tha lamps upon tha pure candlestick before tha LORD continually.
N u will take fine flour, N bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
N u will set ’em in two rows, six on a row, upon tha pure table before tha LORD.
N u will put pure frankincense upon each row, dat it may be on tha bread 4 a memorial, even an offering made by fire 2 tha LORD.
Every sabbath he shall set it in order before tha LORD continually, bein taken from tha children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
N it will be Aaron’s N his sons’; N dey shall eat it in tha holy place: 4 it is most holy 2 him of tha offerings of tha LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
N tha son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among tha children of Israel: N dis son of tha Israelitish woman N a man of Israel strove together in tha camp;
N tha Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed tha name of tha LORD, N cursed. N dey brought him 2 Moses: (N his mother’s name was Shelomith, tha daughter of Dibri, of tha tribe of Dan:)
N dey put him in ward, dat tha mind of tha LORD might be showed ’em.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
Bring forth him dat has cursed without tha camp; N let all dat heard him lay their hands upon his head, N let all tha congregation stone him.
N u will speak 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

N he dat blasphemeth tha name of tha LORD, he shall surely be put 2 death, N all tha congregation shall certainly stone him: as well tha stranger, as he dat is born in tha land, when he blasphemeth tha name of tha LORD, shall be put 2 death.
N he dat kills any man shall surely be put 2 death.
N he dat kills a beast shall make it good; beast 4 beast.
N if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he has done, so shall it be done 2 him;
Breach 4 breach, eye 4 eye, tooth 4 tooth: as he has caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done 2 him again.
N he dat kills a beast, he shall restore it: N he dat kills a man, he shall be put 2 death.
y’all shall have one manner of law, as well 4 tha stranger, as 4 one of ur own country: 4 I am tha LORD ur God.
N Moses spoke 2 tha children of Israel, dat dey should bring forth him dat had cursed out of tha camp, N stone him wit stones. N tha children of Israel did as tha LORD commanded Moses.

25.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses in mount Sinai, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, N say 2 ’em, When y’all come in2 tha land which I give u, then shall tha land keep a sabbath 2 tha LORD.
Six years u will sow ur field, N six years u will prune ur vineyard, N gather in tha fruit of it;
But in tha seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest 2 tha land, a sabbath 4 tha LORD: u will neither sow ur field, nor prune ur vineyard.
Dat which grows of its own accord of ur harvest u will not reap, neither gather tha grapes of ur vine undressed: 4 it is a year of rest 2 tha land.
N tha sabbath of tha land shall be food 4 u; 4 u, N 4 ur servant, N 4 ur maid, N 4 ur hired servant, N 4 ur stranger dat stays wit u,
N 4 ur cattle, N 4 tha beast dat r in ur land, shall all tha increase of it be food.
N u will number seven sabbaths of years 2 u, seven times seven years; N tha space of tha seven sabbaths of years shall be 2 u forty N nine years.
Then will u cause tha trumpet of tha jubile 2 sound on tha tenth day of tha seventh month, in tha day of atonement shall y’all make tha trumpet sound throughout all ur land.

N y’all shall hallow tha fiftieth year, N proclaim liberty throughout all tha land 2 all tha inhabitants of it: it shall be a jubile 2 u; N y’all shall return every man 2 his possession, N y’all shall return every man 2 his family.
A jubile shall dat fiftieth year be 2 u: y’all shall not sow, neither reap dat which grows of itself in it, nor gather tha grapes in it of ur vine undressed.
4 it is tha jubile; it shall be holy 2 u: y’all shall eat tha increase of it out of tha field.
In tha year of dis jubile y’all shall return every man 2 his possession.
N if u sell ought 2 ur neighbour, or buyest ought of ur neighbour’s hand, y’all shall not oppress one another:
According 2 tha number of years after tha jubile u will buy of ur neighbour, N according 2 tha number of years of tha fruits he shall sell 2 u:

According 2 tha crowd of years u will increase tha price of it, N according 2 tha fewness of years u will diminish tha price of it: 4 according 2 tha number of tha years of tha fruits does he sell 2 u.
y’all shall not therefore oppress one another; but u will fear ur God: 4 I am tha LORD ur God.
So y’all shall do my statutes, N keep my judgments, N do ’em; N y’all shall live in tha land in safety.
N tha land shall yield her fruit, N y’all shall eat ur fill, N live in it in safety.
N if y’all shall say, What shall we eat tha seventh year? look, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
Then I will command my blessing upon u in tha sixth year, N it shall bring forth fruit 4 three years.
N y’all shall sow tha eighth year, N eat yet of old fruit until tha ninth year; until her fruits come in y’all shall eat of tha old store.
Tha land shall not be sold 4 ever: 4 tha land is mine; 4 y’all r strangers N sojourners wit me.
N in all tha land of ur possession y’all shall grant a redemption 4 tha land.
If ur brother be waxen poor, N has sold away some of his possession, N if any of his kin come 2 redeem it, then shall he redeem dat which his brother sold.
N if tha man have none 2 redeem it, N himself be able 2 redeem it;
Then let him count tha years of tha sale of it, N restore tha overplus 2 tha man 2 whom he sold it; dat he may return 2 his possession.

But if he don’t be able 2 restore it 2 him, then dat which is sold shall remain in tha hand of him dat has bought it until tha year of jubile: N in tha jubile it shall go out, N he shall return 2 his possession.
N if a man sell a livin house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

N if it don’t be redeemed within tha space of a full year, then tha house dat is in tha walled city shall be established 4 ever 2 him dat bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in tha jubile.
But tha houses of tha villages which have no wall round about ’em shall be counted as tha fields of tha country: dey may be redeemed, N dey shall go out in tha jubile.
Even so tha citiez of tha Levites, N tha houses of tha citiez of their possession, may tha Levites redeem at any time.

N if a man purchase of tha Levites, then tha house dat was sold, N tha city of his possession, shall go out in tha year of jubile: 4 tha houses of tha citiez of tha Levites r their possession among tha children of Israel.
But tha field of tha suburbs of their citiez may not be sold; 4 it is their perpetual possession.
N if ur brother be waxen poor, N fallen in decay wit u; then u will relieve him: yeah, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; dat he may live wit u.
Take u no usury of him, or increase: but fear ur God; dat ur brother may live wit u.
u will not give him ur money upon usury, nor lend him ur food 4 increase.
I am tha LORD ur God, which brought u forth out of tha land of Egypt, 2 give u tha land of Canaan, N 2 be ur God.
N if ur brother dat lives by u be waxen poor, N be sold 2 u; u will not compel him 2 serve as a bondservant:
But as an hired servant, N as a sojourner, he shall be wit u, N shall serve u 2 tha year of jubile:
N then shall he depart from u, both he N his children wit him, N shall return 2 his own family, N 2 tha possession of his fathers shall he return.
4 dey r my servants, which I brought forth out of tha land of Egypt: dey shall not be sold as bondmen.
u will not rule over him wit rigour; but will fear ur God.
Both ur bondmen, N ur bondmaids, which u will have, shall be of tha heathen dat r round about u; of ’em shall y’all buy bondmen N bondmaids.
Moreover of tha children of tha strangers dat do stay among u, of ’em shall y’all buy, N of their families dat r wit u, which dey fathered in ur land: N dey shall be ur possession.

N y’all shall take ’em as an inheritance 4 ur children after u, 2 inherit ’em 4 a possession; dey shall be ur bondmen 4 ever: but over ur brothers tha children of Israel, y’all shall not rule one over another wit rigour.
N if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by u, N ur brother dat lives by him wax poor, N sell himself 2 tha stranger or sojourner by u, or 2 tha stock of tha stranger’s family:
After dat he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brothers may redeem him:
Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any dat is nigh of kin 2 him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

N he shall reckon wit him dat bought him from tha year dat he was sold 2 him 2 tha year of jubile: N tha price of his sale shall be according 2 tha number of years, according 2 tha time of an hired servant shall it be wit him.
If there be yet many years behind, according 2 ’em he shall give again tha price of his redemption out of tha money dat he was bought 4.
N if there remain but few years 2 tha year of jubile, then he shall count wit him, N according 2 his years shall he give him again tha price of his redemption.
N as a yearly hired servant shall he be wit him: N tha other shall not rule wit rigour over him in ur sight.
N if he don’t be redeemed in dese years, then he shall go out in tha year of jubile, both he, N his children wit him.
4 2 me tha children of Israel r servants; dey r my servants whom I brought forth out of tha land of Egypt: I am tha LORD ur God.

27.text: N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses, sayin,
